faqs.question: Does “Ordinary Portland cement mortar” add a cell to concrete pump priming?
faqs.answer: No. ACI 304.2R states the mechanism: pumped concrete moves as a cylinder riding on a thin lubricating film of grout or mortar on the inside diameter of the pipeline.

faqs.question: Can “Polymer cement mortar” fill a blank cell for concrete pump priming?
faqs.answer: No. Blank cells for concrete pump priming stay blank.

faqs.question: 「Ordinary Portland cement mortar」会给混凝土泵开泵润滑（用水泥浆，不用水）增加单元格吗？
faqs.answer: 不会。ACI 304.2R 说明机理：泵送混凝土像圆柱体一样，沿管内壁一层薄水泥浆或砂浆润滑膜前进。开泵前，必须用水泥浆或专用底涂把整个内径涂满。流量建立且配合比稳定后，这层膜才能维持。

faqs.question: 「Polymer cement mortar」能补上混凝土泵开泵润滑（用水泥浆，不用水）的空白格吗？
faqs.answer: 不能。混凝土泵开泵润滑（用水泥浆，不用水）没写出来的格子继续空着。
